meta.source: Built from GD Presentation Design System 1.0 (palette, Fira Sans, voice) and the Grid Dynamics website hero (ground colour, pill CTAs, prism-cube artwork).

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind every glass layer. Sampled from the Grid Dynamics website hero ground; dark is a near-black blue-grey. Never put glass on plain white: it disappears.

tokens.name: ground-alt
tokens.usage: Flat, non-glass content areas (long tables, document bodies). GD warm-gray surface from the brand palette.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text and icons. On ground ≥13:1; on glass-fill and glass-fill-strong over any brand imagery ≥6:1 (light) / ≥6:1 (dark).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ground and on glass-fill-strong (≥6.5:1). On regular glass-fill only at 24px+ or bold 19px+ (≥3.8:1 worst case).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: placeholders, metadata, captions on ground and glass-fill-strong (≥5.4:1). Not for text on regular glass-fill.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: GD Mellow Yellow, solid. Switch on-state, stat bars, accent tags, cover blocks. Primary buttons use the tinted yellow-glass instead. A fill, never a text colour on light grounds. Ink on it 9.7:1.

tokens.name: yellow-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for solid yellow surfaces (GD yellow tint 1). Ink on it 11.4:1.

tokens.name: yellow-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill and on-state border for solid yellow surfaces. Derived: yellow darkened 10% (not in the brand book). Ink on it 7.8:1.

tokens.name: on-yellow
tokens.usage: Text and icons on solid yellow, yellow-hover, yellow-pressed in both themes.

tokens.name: yellow-glass
tokens.usage: Primary button fill: tinted, semi-transparent yellow glass over a backdrop blur. Text on-yellow-glass ≥5.3:1 (light) and ≥4.5:1 (dark) over any brand imagery.

tokens.name: yellow-glass-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover. Light: denser tint. Dark: same fill (more yellow would drop text contrast); the brighter rim and glow carry the hover.

tokens.name: yellow-glass-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed state, paired with the 0.97 scale.

tokens.name: yellow-glass-rim
tokens.usage: 1px rim on yellow-glass buttons: a warm edge catching light, instead of the white glass-rim.

tokens.name: yellow-glass-rim-hover
tokens.usage: Rim on hover for yellow-glass buttons; in dark theme this is the main hover cue.

tokens.name: on-yellow-glass
tokens.usage: Text on yellow-glass in both themes: dark ink in light theme, light ink in dark theme.

tokens.name: yellow-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet highlight fill behind ink text (selected rows, notices). Ink on it ≥12:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: GD secondary. Data visualisation and decorative prism washes only; never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: sea-blue
tokens.usage: GD secondary. Data visualisation and prism washes.

tokens.name: sky-blue
tokens.usage: GD secondary. Data visualisation and prism washes; its cyan cast is what reads as 'glass' in the hero artwork.

tokens.name: grass
tokens.usage: GD secondary. Data visualisation only.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Regular Liquid Glass material: nav bars, tab bars, cards, controls floating over ground or imagery. Carries ink text only (≥6:1 over any brand imagery).

tokens.name: glass-fill-strong
tokens.usage: Thick glass for dense content: sheets, dialogs, menus, forms, any text-heavy panel over imagery. All text tokens pass on it.

tokens.name: glass-fill-subtle
tokens.usage: Clear glass for secondary chips and inset tracks inside another glass layer. Never the only layer under text.

tokens.name: glass-tint
tokens.usage: Yellow-tinted glass: the sliding selection lens in segmented controls and tab bars, with ink text on top.

tokens.name: glass-rim
tokens.usage: 1px rim around every glass shape; catches light like the edge of the hero cubes.

tokens.name: glass-sheen
tokens.usage: Diagonal specular sheen across the top-left of glass (the ::before layer).

tokens.name: glass-rib
tokens.usage: Fine vertical ribbing from the brand artwork: optional texture on large hero glass only.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers inside flat content and inside glass-fill-strong. Source: GD 1.5px card border colour.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring with 2px offset, on every interactive element. ≥3.3:1 on ground and glass in both themes.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the page behind a Sheet or dialog.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text and marks. ≥6:1 on ground and glass-fill-strong. Always with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and marks (grass, darkened for text). ≥6:1 on ground and glass-fill-strong. Pair with a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and marks (coral, darkened for text). ≥5.2:1 on ground and glass-fill-strong. Differs from success in lightness and hue; always with a word.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Diagram canvas ground: a calmer, lighter step of ground so nodes and lines read first.

tokens.name: canvas-grid
tokens.usage: Dot grid on the diagram canvas (1.5px dots every space-md). Decorative only.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Default connector: synchronous call or process flow. 1.5px, ≥7:1 on canvas.

tokens.name: edge-data
tokens.usage: Data-flow connector (reads, writes, replication). Sea blue; ≥4.3:1 on canvas in both themes. Always distinguish by legend too.

tokens.name: edge-highlight
tokens.usage: Selected or critical-path connector line, 2.5px, drawn over an edge-halo.

tokens.name: edge-halo
tokens.usage: 8px yellow halo under highlighted connectors and around the selected node rim. Decorative: the ink line carries the meaning.

tokens.name: node-tint-service
tokens.usage: Icon tile behind services, apps, gateways, steps.

tokens.name: node-tint-data
tokens.usage: Icon tile behind databases and storage (sky blue).

tokens.name: node-tint-queue
tokens.usage: Icon tile behind queues, streams and events (coral).

tokens.name: node-tint-ai
tokens.usage: Icon tile behind AI models and agents (yellow glass).

tokens.name: group-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of boundary groups (cloud account, VPC, domain, team) behind nodes.

tokens.name: group-border
tokens.usage: 1.5px dashed boundary of groups and external systems. ≥5:1 on canvas.

tokens.name: severity-critical
tokens.usage: Critical severity badge fill (four bars). Text on it is on-severity-critical.

tokens.name: on-severity-critical
tokens.usage: Text and bars on severity-critical: 6.4:1 light, 7.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: severity-high-tint
tokens.usage: High severity badge fill (three bars), with danger text: ≥4.7:1 on glass-fill-strong in both themes.

tokens.name: severity-medium-tint
tokens.usage: Medium severity badge fill (two bars), with ink text.

tokens.name: severity-low-tint
tokens.usage: Low severity badge fill (one bar), with ink-2 text.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: 'Needs attention' tag fill, with ink text and a yellow-pressed dot.

tokens.name: mention-tint
tokens.usage: @mention chips inside comments and inputs, with info text (≥4.6:1 on glass-fill-strong).

tokens.name: highlight-mark
tokens.usage: Commented or selected text in documents (background of <mark>), with ink text.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Marketing-scale hero headline, as on the Grid Dynamics website. One per screen.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen hero titles and empty states.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big numerals in StatCard. Pair with a caption in ink-2.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Page titles. Sentence case, no trailing period.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Card titles; mirrors the 20 pt deck title.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs under a hero, as on the website.
styles.sample: Trusted by Fortune 1000 leaders for AI consulting, engineering, and platforms

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Bring an AI use-case — leave with a delivery plan.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense UI, table cells, helper text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata and stat labels in ink-2 or ink-3.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels, UPPERCASE as on the website CTAs.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Segmented controls, tabs, tags, field labels.

tokens.name: space-2xs
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, lens inset inside segmented controls. Added for UI density (not in the deck scale).

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Tight gaps between chips and inside compact controls.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Control padding, gaps between related rows.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Card padding and gutters between glass cards.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Section spacing inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Screen margins on desktop; space above heroes.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Hero and marketing section spacing.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Flat, non-glass content: tables, charts, images, document bodies. Keeps GD's rectilinear voice.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inner elements in a 14px-padded parent: fields inside cards, lenses inside 24px tracks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Small glass cards, menus, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Standard glass cards and the NavBar on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, large hero glass. Concentric rule: inner radius = outer radius − padding.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, switches, segmented controls, TabBar: the capsule shape of the website CTAs.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Every resting glass surface: top specular edge, bottom shade, soft lift.

tokens.name: shadow-glass-float
tokens.usage: Floating layers: Sheets, dialogs, menus, the dragged lens.

tokens.name: shadow-yellow
tokens.usage: Primary yellow-glass buttons: specular top edge plus a warm glow instead of a grey drop shadow.

tokens.name: blur-sm
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur for small controls (switch thumb, tags on imagery).

tokens.name: blur-md
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur for regular glass: nav, tab bars, cards.

tokens.name: blur-lg
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur for glass-fill-strong sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: saturate-glass
tokens.usage: Backdrop saturate() paired with every blur, so colour behind the glass glows rather than greys out.
